"What are some items that should be included in a basic first aid kit?" Contents of the kit should include: • basic first aid notes • individually wrapped sterile adhesive dressings • sterile eye pads • sterile coverings for serious wounds • triangular bandages • safety pins • sterile unmedicated wound dressings - small, medium, large • adhesive tape • rubber thread or crepe bandages • scissors • disposable gloves • eye baths
